task: CYBERMEDICA / КИБЕРМЕДИКА — PRODUCTION PERFORMANCE CORRECTIVE v1

method.note: The complete cold-run set was captured on runtime-equivalent deployment dpl_5wDEH94xRe97Ja2Koc12kmmfP5zU. Subsequent changes only corrected foreground contrast, a stale image-size test expectation, and an accessible-name advisory. The final runtime was rebuilt and smoke-tested.

rootCauses.documentTtfb: Anonymous SSR paths repeated the complete published-projection transport read. Production logs showed successful reads taking 1450–3566 ms and transient fallback paths waiting about 10708–10794 ms.
rootCauses.mobileLcp: The Hamilton-T1 hero image was discovered after the blocking catalog read and used an oversized responsive candidate. The old trace attributed about 3242 ms to resource-load delay.
rootCauses.desktopCls: The global streaming shell reserved only 70vh, allowing the footer to render too high and shift when page content replaced the shell.
rootCauses.console: No first-party runtime error remained. Vercel Preview injects its feedback toolbar, which the canonical CSP correctly blocks; the production runtime does not inject this toolbar.

correctives.catalogCache: Validated 60-second server cache shared by public reads, plus request memoization. The health endpoint explicitly bypasses this cache.
correctives.images: True homepage LCP receives a server-emitted responsive preload hint and high fetch priority; responsive sizes were tightened for hero, cards and gallery; below-fold carousel media is lazy; logo intrinsic sizes were reduced.
correctives.layout: The global loading shell now reserves a full viewport.
correctives.javascript: The Metrica queue remains immediate, while the external script loads after five seconds or first pointer/keyboard intent. R9 first/last-touch and rfq_success contracts remain covered.
correctives.fonts: The storefront uses the system typography stack and issues no custom-font network requests, so no font preload or weight change was justified.
correctives.cacheHeaders: Hashed Next.js assets retain immutable caching and optimized images retain the existing 60-day revalidation policy. Mutable HTML and RFQ/API responses were not given immutable caching.

previewOnlyAdvisories: Vercel Preview feedback toolbar is blocked by the canonical script-src CSP
Broad HSTS/Trusted Types changes remain outside this performance corrective

stageHealthDiagnostic.reason: Preview does not receive or impersonate the Production service boundary; health reports the fallback honestly while the approved Stage catalog source remains isolated.
